title: Ilocos Pink (Gameng) garlic (Ilocos Pink): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Ilocos Pink (Gameng) garlic: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: Ilocos Pink (Gameng) garlic is a garlic variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Ilocos Pink (Gameng) is a registered garlic variety, also sold or known as Ilocos Pink or Gameng. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2017 as NSIC 2017 Gr 03. DA RFO I bred it. It takes about 111 days from planting to harvest, with 6,450 kilograms per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Ilocos Pink or Gameng, this is the same garlic. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [garlic variety finder](/crop-varieties/garlic), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for onion and garlic](/land-preparation/onion-garlic-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Ilocos Pink (Gameng) garlic takes about 111 days from planting to harvest. That is about the average of the 7 garlic varieties with a day count, 113.7 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6,450 kg/ha beats the average of its group, 5817.14. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 111 days after planting.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [purple blotch of onion](/diseases/purple-blotch), [thrips](/pests/thrips).

The pests and diseases that hit garlic fields most often: [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt), [onion armyworm](/pests/onion-armyworm), [purple blotch of onion](/diseases/purple-blotch). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** 6.45 t/ha on raised beds, 5.02 t/ha with minimum tillage (NSIC trials).
**Fruit:** Globe shaped bulb with several layers of cloves, pink clove skin, white outer skin with brown stripes.
**Season:** Dry season, needs cool, windy weather during the growing period.
Moderately resistant to purple blotch, Cercospora leaf spot and Fusarium bulb rot (NSIC).
Only slight thrips, leaf folder and mite damage in the NSIC trials.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: registered with NSIC in 2017, BPI's garlic guide lists Ilocos Pink among the garlic varieties found in the country. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Ilocos Pink (Gameng) garlic

It is recommended for the dry season. Native Ilocos garlic is small but strong in flavor and keeps well. Plant cloves from a clean, local source after the rains, because garlic needs the cool, dry months. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is Ilocos Pink the same as Ilocos Pink (Gameng)?
items.a: Yes. Ilocos Pink is another name for Ilocos Pink (Gameng), registered as NSIC 2017 Gr 03. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 111 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 6,450 kilograms per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Ilocos Pink (Gameng)?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
